case.title: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH. Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor. Need: 30000 kits a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 5 days). Fallback if you walk away: today's terms continue unchanged. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70610.subject: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
sup:70610.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to submit our offer for your consideration. We can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months.

As a valued partner, we always strive to support your operations with our extensive inventory and reliable delivery service. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our successful business relationship and standing by as your trusted partner for all your supply needs.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
message.body:
Dear Mr Stadler,

Thank you for your kind offer and for the reliable service Leitner & Sohn has given us. We would like to bundle our fastener kit with one partner, and we would be glad if that partner were your family company.

Before we settle the price, please consider two points from our side:

German producer prices for fasteners changed +1.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2594@2025-08, idx:PPI-C2594@2026-08).

We also buy Hex bolt ISO 4017 M16x60 8.8, zinc from another source, at EUR 37.81 per 100 units on 2024-10-08 (po:4500011529-10) and EUR 37.64 per 100 units on 2026-09-24 (po:4500014454-10).

On that basis we cannot accept the quoted price. Here is our proposal:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.26; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.11; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.23; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months.

Each option offers a longer contract term, which gives you stability. If faster payment suits you better, Option C keeps your current payment terms. We look forward to a fair solution for both family companies.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
message.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
message.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose. However, the price history data you cite does not concern this part or our company. Please note that the competitor pricing provided refers to a different part, and the slight increase in the producer price index also limits our room to maneuver. 

We welcome your proposal for a 24-month contract, as this stability allows us to adjust our pricing. Building on your Option C, we can offer a price of €5.53 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2594, LCI-C. 

Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

On that basis, and with the longer term you asked for in every option, we propose:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.29; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

Each option is a genuine route to a fair, lasting agreement between our two family companies.

Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

message.from_name: Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
message.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
message.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH. We value our relationship and always strive to deliver the exceptional service and extensive range you expect from us.

We have reviewed the data provided; however, the price history for individual washers does not reflect the cost structure of the entire bundled kit. Furthermore, the price history data you cite does not concern this part or our company. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2594, LCI-C. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Additionally, please provide the documentation for the competitor pricing you referenced, as we cannot verify it.

Building on your Option C, we can reduce our price to EUR 5.49 per unit, maintaining the 30-day payment term and 24-month contract. Beside this alternative, our current offer is a price of €5.53 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our offer is valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
